newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Bovespa sees 380.7 mln reais inflows in July.
newsitem.headline: Bovespa sees 380.7 mln reais inflows in July.

text.p: The Sao Paulo Stock Exchange (Bovespa) said net foreign capital inflows rose to 380.7 million reais in July from just 22.1 million in June.
Foreign buys in July totalled 6.531 billion reais, against foreign sales of 6.150 billion, it said in a statement.
So far this year, net foreign investment in the Sao Paulo bourse has totalled 1.829 billion reais, it added.
